params.note: Fix verification run: full magellan:latest image rebuilt from experiments branch HEAD (5d37674) with the sr_update return-value fix applied (magellan/main.py, magellan/updater.py). summary: FIX CONFIRMED on the real experiments branch. With the sr_update return-value fix applied to magellan/main.py and magellan/updater.py, the full 4090 config (TF32 on, empty_cache gating, everything) reproduces the healthy signature -- and faster than any prior run in this project's history: grasp>=0.5 by ep 3001, >=0.9 by ep 4008, 1.0 by ep 6007, zero collapses through 20000 episodes. This closes out the grasp regression that began ~2026-07-20 and blocked the paper-fidelity experiment plan.

findings.description: grasp>=0.9 by ep 4008 -- faster than the paper's 20-50k window and faster than any pre-regression healthy run in this project (previous best was ep 10009 in f194847f/832c0e23-era runs).
findings.recommendation: Regression resolved. Commit the fix, update REGRESSION_HANDOFF.md and FP32_BOTTLENECK.md to reflect the resolution, then resume the blocked paper-fidelity experiment plan (PAPER_FIDELITY_PLAN.md).

comparison: Matches the bisect-worktree confirmation (6c532ea9, same fix on top of 4f33ebe with a hand-built config) -- this run proves the fix holds on the actual current codebase with the real production config, not just the isolated bisect setup.
paper_vs_run: ABOVE_PAPER: grasp>=0.9 by ep 4008 vs. paper's 20-50k window.
